segments.name: Beef
segments.description: Processes live fed cattle and fabricates dressed beef into cuts and case-ready products sold to retailers and foodservice.
segments.evidence: Beef includes our operations related to processing live fed cattle and fabricating dressed beef carcasses into primal and sub-primal cuts and case-ready products.

segments.name: Pork
segments.description: Processes live market hogs and fabricates pork into cuts and case-ready products for retail, foodservice and export.
segments.evidence: Pork includes our operations related to processing live market hogs and fabricating pork carcasses into primal and sub-primal cuts and case-ready products.

segments.name: Chicken
products: fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products
segments.description: Raises and processes chickens into fresh, frozen and value-added products sold to retailers, foodservice and export markets.
segments.evidence: Chicken includes our domestic operations related to raising and processing live chickens into and purchasing raw materials for fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products, as well as sales from specialty products.

segments.name: Prepared Foods
segments.description: Manufactures and markets frozen and refrigerated food products under brands such as Jimmy Dean, Hillshire Farm and Ball Park.
segments.evidence: This segment includes brands such as Jimmy Dean ®, Hillshire Farm ®, Ball Park ®, Wright ® and State Fair ®, as well as the artisanal brands aidells ® and Gallo Salame ®.

segments.name: International
products: fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products
other protein and non-protein food products
segments.description: Foreign operations that raise and process chickens and distribute chicken and other protein food products in several countries.
segments.evidence: International includes our foreign operations in China, Europe, Malaysia, Mexico, South Korea, Thailand and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia related to raising and processing live chickens into and purchasing raw materials for fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products, as well as the distribution of chicken products and other protein and non-protein food products.

revenueModel.text: Retailers, foodservice distributors, restaurant operators and other customers pay the company for its meat and food products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are marketed and sold primarily by our sales staff to grocery retailers, grocery wholesalers, meat distributors, warehouse club stores, military commissaries, industrial food processing companies, chain restaurants or their distributors, live markets, international export companies and domestic distributors who serve restaurants, foodservice operations such as plant and school cafeterias, convenience stores, hospitals and other vendors.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, International was identified as a reportable segment, previously presented within International/Other.
changes.evidence: Effective in the first quarter of fiscal 2026, International was identified as a reportable segment.
